Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the film’s director by applying a flawed “first-listed-director” heuristic and treating Anthony Asquith (director of the British remake Unfinished Symphony, 1934) as the director of Gently My Songs Entreat (the 1933 film directed by Willi Forst). This conflation led the workflow toward Asquith’s birthplace (London) instead of the correct answer (Willi Forst was Viennese, i.e., born in Vienna).
